verdict.rationale: Supermemory's docs say it automatically extracts memories from raw content, including conversations (docs-1). It builds a living knowledge graph of facts on top of other facts (docs-14) and keeps user profiles automatically maintained and updated as users interact (docs-15, docs-33). It also processes only new content on repeat ingestion (docs-30) and lets you guide what matters during ingestion (docs-45), so the system itself decides what to retain and consolidates over time. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that consolidation runs asynchronously in the background, details of how salience and deduplication or conflict decisions are made, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
